controls.name: Chn. Aftertouch
notes: Named host control; physical conversion has not passed independent qualification.
Stock generator; captured through native host parameter APIs without synthetic keyboard or mouse input.
The profile binds the observed name, parameter count and layout. Binary hash is provenance, not an automatic live DLL attestation.
Normalized-only controls have no qualified physical conversion. Read host metadata before writing; project/preset/hidden-state controls need separate care.

The host setter quantizes values more coarsely than saved presets. Qualification restores a separately captured write-reachable lab baseline; it does not claim exact restoration of the original preset.
